lost.title: Close {name} as lost
lost.body: Protection for this contact ends now and any registered deal closes with it. This cannot be reopened; if the customer comes back later, register them again.
lost.noteHint: For example the winning price or how the spec differed — it helps the team tune prices

list.intro: Everyone you are talking to, from first contact to a closed sale. Each contact stays protected for {days} days.
list.boardHint: Drag a card to another stage, or use Move to… on the card
list.importPhone: Import leads from a CSV file

filters.searchPlaceholder: Name, shop, phone, e-mail or LINE

empty.allTitle: Start by registering your first customer
empty.allBody: Register them before you meet. Their contact is protected for you, and the pipeline walks you to a closed sale.
empty.importInstead: Already have a list? Import a CSV
empty.todayBody: Set a follow-up on any lead and you will be reminded at that date and time
empty.endingBody: Leads with less than 7 days of protection left appear here — close them or send a quote
empty.closedBody: Won and lost leads are kept here with their reasons
empty.filteredBody: Try another search or clear the filters

drafts.title: {count} waiting to send

drafts.onlineHint: Back online — sending the saved leads
drafts.refusedToast: {count} leads could not be sent — see why in the queue

newLead.title: New lead
newLead.intro: A phone number, e-mail or tax id is needed. The contact is protected for you for {days} days.
newLead.scanHint: Take a photo and the form fills itself — check it before saving
newLead.scanDoneHint: Fields outlined in amber were hard to read — check them before saving. The photo is deleted later.
newLead.scanFailed: Couldn't read the card. Take another photo or type the details.
newLead.contactHint: Used to link the customer to you when they sign up; protected for {days} days
newLead.lineIdHint: To open a chat from the lead
newLead.ownLead: This contact is already one of your leads
newLead.unavailableHint: Try another way to reach them, or keep talking to them through your link
newLead.followUpHint: You will be reminded at this time
newLead.noteExample: e.g. wants 1,000 bakery boxes a month
newLead.consent: The customer agreed to be contacted by getpack
newLead.savedOffline: You are offline — saved on this device and sent when you are back online
newLead.partnerNote: Know a manufacturer who would like to work with getpack? Send them the partner page.

errors.phone: That phone number doesn't look right
errors.contact: Add a phone number, e-mail or tax id

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.intro: Quotes you sent to your leads — see whether each customer opened or accepted it
quotes.emptyBody: Open a lead, tap Send a quote, pick a product — the price is worked out at once — then send the link on LINE

newQuote.title: Send a quote
newQuote.pickLeadIntro: Every quote belongs to one lead. Choose who it is for first.
newQuote.noLeadsBody: Register a lead first, then send a quote from their page
newQuote.noProducts: No products can be priced instantly right now
newQuote.notInstant: This product can't be priced instantly yet — choose another
newQuote.quantityHint: Choose up to {max} quantities so the customer can compare
newQuote.postcodeHint: Optional — adds shipping to the price
newQuote.noPrice: Complete the spec to see the price
newQuote.validity: This price holds for {days} days from today.

newQuote.shareMessage: A packaging quote from getpack for Khun {name}

quote.title: Quote
quote.vatNote: Prices include VAT, as the customer sees them on getpack.co
quote.shareBody: Link sent {count} times. It keeps working until you send a new one or withdraw the quote.
quote.shareMessage: A packaging quote from getpack for Khun {name}

closed.expired: This quote has expired — send a new one from the lead
closed.withdrawn: This quote was withdrawn; its link no longer works

quote.dealDone: Deal registered — protected and your commission rate locked
quote.resent: New link created; the old one no longer works
quote.withdrawBody: The link sent to {name} stops working at once. This cannot be undone.

discount.title: Discount
discount.pageIntro: Tell getpack what {name} can give in return; the discount comes back as options for you to choose
discount.none: No discount asked. The quote shows the same price everyone sees.

discount.alreadyOpen: A request is already waiting for an answer

discount.quoteClosed: This quote is closed — a discount can't be requested

giveGet.intro: Choose at least one — a discount is always traded for terms
giveGet.introAgain: A new round needs at least one term that differs from the last round

quantity.title: Order more
quantity.body: Per order — the unit price really drops

callOff.title: Call-off contract
callOff.body: The price is locked for the whole contract

cash.title: Pay sooner
cash.body: Paid in full within a few days

spec.title: Change the spec
spec.body: e.g. fewer colours, finish, board grade

discount.pctHint: e.g. 6 — getpack may offer different options

evidence.title: The other supplier's quote
evidence.body: Attach the file, or fill in the spec line by line — a lower price often comes from a different spec
evidence.notesExample: e.g. no file check or proof

review.whatNextBody: getpack sends options back to this quote. The first option always keeps your full commission rate. A special price is short-lived and comes with its conditions.

errors.evidence: Attach their quote or fill in their spec and price
errors.price: Enter the price as a number

import.consent: Everyone in the file agreed to be contacted by getpack

import.checkBody: Rows with problems are left out. Fix them in the file and check again.

errorCodes.contact_missing: Needs a phone, e-mail or tax id
errorCodes.invalid_amount: The value must be a number
errorCodes.duplicate_in_file: Duplicates another row in the file

errors.empty: Choose a file or paste the data first

waiting.payment: Waiting for the customer to pay in full
